annotations.title: Read a GeoThought project with this agent

description: Use when the user wants this assistant, rather than GeoThought's own model, to read a project's documents and answer its schemas' questions. Queues the documents that have no answer yet; the answers given are saved with the project. Optional `schemas` (names) to ask only some of its schemas' questions, `documents` (report keys such as A24950) to read only some, `limit` to queue only that many documents. Returns the reading's id and size; continue with geothought_next_document. Reading costs the assistant model's tokens: roughly 10k-30k input tokens a document for a schema of a few dozen questions.
name: geothought_start_agent_reading
title: Read a GeoThought project with this agent
